caption:
OUR MOST POINTS EVER 🎮🏀 145. Against the Warriors.

• Jan 20, 2026: we beat Golden State 145-127, our franchise record for points in a game
• IQ: 40 points on 11-of-13 shooting

Can we ever top 145? 👇
